title: metais.render/1
description: What metais render prints with --json: where the outputs went, and one record per file written (ADR-008 D8 item 9, ADR-005 D16 item 2).

out.description: Where the outputs went: directory for --out <dir>, stdout for --out -; the path itself is never echoed.

dry_run.description: Whether --dry-run was given, so that nothing was written.

files.description: One record per top-level file written, or that a dry run would write, in byte order of its path; with --only, the selected file alone.

sample.description: The sample settings of a render with --sample, or null.

path.description: The file's path relative to the output directory, /-separated.

output.description: The id of the declaration that wrote it.

item.description: The 0-based index of the for_each element it was rendered for, or null.

source.description: What wrote it: template, asset or container.

kind.description: The file's kind, for a template file (ADR-005 D7), and null for a container and for a file copied from an asset, which have none.

digest.description: sha256: and the lowercase hex SHA-256 of the file's bytes.

executable.description: Whether the file was written with the owner's execute bit.

status.description: create, for a file written where nothing was; present only when --out is a directory.

entries.description: A container's entries, in the container's order (ADR-005 D8 item 6); absent for any other file.

path.description: The entry's path within its container, /-separated.

output.description: The entry declaration's id, or null when it has none or the profile wrote the entry.

item.description: The 0-based index of the for_each element it was rendered for, or null.

source.description: What wrote it: template, asset or container, or profile for the mimetype entry a profile writes.

kind.description: The entry's kind, for a template file (ADR-005 D7), and null for any other.

method.description: How the container holds it: stored or deflated.

size.description: The entry's uncompressed size in bytes.

digest.description: sha256: and the lowercase hex SHA-256 of the entry's uncompressed bytes.

entries.description: A container entry's own entries, in its order.
